Name: Better Signs
Author: stebaker92
Description:
[size=5][b]Better Signs[/b][/size]

This mod changes the behaviour of Signs and locks any displayed item and text, preventing you from accidentally overwriting signs.

[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Prevents accidentally overwriting existing Signs that display an item or text[/*]
[*]Right clicking on a sign will no longer replace the display item or prompt to change the text[/*]
[*]To change the displayed item or text on a sign, break and re-place the sign. [/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley:[/b] 1.5 & 1.6 Compatible[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI:[/b] 4.1.10+[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Fully supported[/*]
[*][b]Other Mods:[/b] No known conflicts[/*]
[/list][heading]Frequently Asked Questions[/heading]
[b][i]Q: Does this work in multiplayer?
A: Yes, each player with the mod installed will have sign protection.[/i][/b]

[b][i]Q: How do I edit a sign after placing it?[/i][/b]
A: Break the sign and place it again. This prevents accidental changes while allowing intentional edits.
